_context.nav.logo: Menu opened by a right click on the Rerun logo of the top bar.
_context.nav.goToApp: Top bar button shown instead of the sign-up button to a visitor who is already signed in to the app.
_context.nav.trialCta: The price stays in US dollars in every language.
_context.finalCta.titleLead: <switch></switch> is a rotating pill naming the AI provider (ChatGPT, Claude...). The title is split in two lines: titleLead then titleTail.
_context.openSource.announce: <wide> wraps the part hidden on small screens.
_context.og.default.line1: The social card of the site (1200x630 image): three short lines, the last one highlighted. Keep each line short.
_context.dialog.close: Screen reader label of the X button that closes a dialog.
_context.nav.items.whiteLabel: Top bar link to the page for agencies that resell the product under their own brand. "White label" is the commercial term.
_context.app.download: Button of the top bar and the home page: downloads the desktop app, or opens the store on a phone. Keep it short.
_context.app.appStore: Use Apple's own wording of its badge in this language.
_context.app.playStore: Use Google's own wording of its badge in this language.
_context.app.menu: Screen reader label of the button that opens the list of systems.
_context.app.mac: Name of the operating system, keep it as is.
_context.app.windows: Name of the operating system, keep it as is.
_context.app.linux: Name of the operating system, keep it as is.
_context.app.appleSilicon: Apple's name for its own Mac chips, keep it as is.
_context.app.arm64: PCs with an Arm chip, keep the word Arm.
_context.app.appImage: A Linux file format, keep the name.
_context.nav.featureGroups: Titles of the four groups the features menu is split into.
_context.nav.featurePages.tools.label: {connectors} is the number of connected apps (3,000).
_context.nav.breadcrumb: Accessible name of the breadcrumb at the top of a page, read by screen readers.
